_note: Advice reviewed by the project owner.

am.name: የቡና ቅጠል ዝገት
steps: በጣም የተጎዱ ቅጠሎችን ቆርጠው ያስወግዱ።
ቅርንጫፎችን በማስተካከል አየር እንዲገባ ያድርጉ።

om.name: Dhukkuba baala bunaa (ruustii)
steps: Baala baay'ee miidhame muraa balleessaa.
Dameewwan qulqulleessuudhaan qilleensi akka seenu godhaa.

en.name: Coffee leaf rust
steps: Remove badly affected leaves.
Prune branches so air can flow through.

am.name: የቡና ቅጠል ነጠብጣብ (ሰርኮስፖራ)
steps: የተጎዱ ቅጠሎችን ሰብስበው ቅበሩ።
ተክሉ በቂ ውሃና ምግብ እንዲያገኝ ያድርጉ።

om.name: Tuqaa baala bunaa (Cercospora)
steps: Baala miidhame funaanaatii awwaalaa.
Biqilichi bishaanii fi nyaata gahaa akka argatu godhaa.

en.name: Cercospora leaf spot
steps: Collect affected leaves and bury them.
Keep the plant well watered and fed.

am.name: ፎማ (የቅጠልና ቀንበጥ በሽታ)
steps: የተጎዱ ቅጠሎችንና ቀንበጦችን ቆርጠው ያስወግዱ።
ለጋ ተክሎችን ከቀዝቃዛ ነፋስ ይጠብቁ።

om.name: Phoma (dhukkuba baalaa fi dameewwanii)
steps: Baalaa fi dameewwan miidhame muraa balleessaa.
Biqiltoota dargaggoo qilleensa qabbanaa'aa irraa tiksaa.

en.name: Phoma disease
steps: Cut off and remove affected leaves and shoots.
Protect young plants from cold wind.

am.name: ጤናማ ይመስላል
steps: በሳምንት አንድ ጊዜ እንደገና ይመልከቱ።
አሁንም ከተጨነቁ ባለሙያ ይጠይቁ።

om.name: Fayyaa kan qabu fakkaata
steps: Torbaan tokko deebi'aa ilaalaa.
Yoo ammalle kan yaaddoftaan ta'ee ogeessa gaafadhaa.

en.name: Looks healthy
steps: Check again in a week.
If you are still worried, ask a person.

am.name: እርግጠኛ አይደለሁም። የግብርና ባለሙያዎን ይጠይቁ።
steps: በደንብ ብርሃን ባለበት በቅርበት ሌላ ፎቶ ያንሱ።

om.name: Mirkanessu hin dandeenye. Ogeessa qonnaa gaafadhaa.
steps: Ifa gaarii keessatti dhiyeenyaan suuraa biraa kaasaa.

en.name: Not sure. Please ask your extension officer.
steps: Take another close-up photo in good light.
